name: OpenFactCheck
description: OpenFactCheck is a unified factuality evaluation framework for LLMs that includes customizable automatic fact-checking, a unified evaluation framework for assessing factuality from multiple perspectives, and a solution for evaluating the reliability of fact-checkers using human-annotated datasets.
reputation: A recent unified factuality evaluation framework that is useful for research, but it is not yet a widely established community standard benchmark.
notes: Addresses disparate evaluation benchmarks by unifying factuality evaluation; publicly released with three integrated modules.
